UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated nurse or nursing student profile stored under /users/{userId}.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

email.description: User's email address from Google Sign-In.

designation.description: Nursing role or academic year (e.g., Senior Staff Nurse, BSc Nursing Student).

institution.description: Hospital, clinic, or nursing college name.

ward.description: Assigned ward or department (e.g., Surgical Ward, ICU).

registrationId.description: BNMC registration number or student ID.

bio.description: Short professional bio or clinical focus note.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

SavedNote.title: SavedNote
SavedNote.description: Saved AI nursing answer or personal study/ward note under /users/{userId}/notes/{noteId}.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the note owner.

title.description: Title of the saved note or AI answer.

content.description: Body content of the saved answer or nursing note.

category.description: Topic category such as Medical Surgical, Pharmacology, Emergency, or Personal Note.

sourceType.description: Indicates whether saved from AI Chat or authored personally.

depthMode.description: Optional answer depth mode when saved from AI Chat.

pinned.description: Whether the note is pinned at the top of the Files list.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

MedicationItem.title: MedicationItem
MedicationItem.description: Medicine and dosage schedule entry under /users/{userId}/medications/{medId}.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

dose.description: Ordered dose string (e.g., 500 mg, 1 g, 20 IU).

patientLabel.description: Ward, bed, or patient reference label.

active.description: Whether the medication order is currently active.

dosesGivenCount.description: Number of doses logged as administered.

lastGivenAt.description: Optional server timestamp of the last administered dose.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/notes/{noteId}.description: User-scoped collection of saved AI answers and personal nursing notes.

/users/{userId}/medications/{medId}.description: User-scoped collection of managed medicines and dosage logs.
